title: Act As [Expert]
whenToUse: When you need domain-specific vocabulary and perspective

title: Format as Table
whenToUse: When comparing options or showing structured data

title: Context Brief
whenToUse: When you need AI to deeply understand your situation before responding

title: Think Step by Step
whenToUse: Before complex reasoning, analysis, or multi-part problems

title: Maximum [X] Words
whenToUse: When AI tends to over-produce or you need a tight output

title: Devil's Advocate
whenToUse: When you want your idea stress-tested before you commit to it

title: Audience Profile
whenToUse: Before writing anything that needs to land with a specific person or group

title: Before You Answer
whenToUse: Before any question where accuracy or nuance really matters

title: Executive Summary Format
whenToUse: When your output needs to be scannable for a busy reader

title: Casual & Direct
whenToUse: For anything that should sound like a confident human, not a corporate document

title: Formal & Precise
whenToUse: For professional documents, legal or financial writing, academic work
